description: A ground-level photograph depicts a long, industrial conveyor belt transporting light-coloured aggregate material, likely gravel, running parallel to a large, tranquil body of water under a clear blue sky. The water is light blue-green, and a sandy or gravelly bank separates it from the conveyor system. A sparse treeline is visible in the distant background, and a light pole stands to the right of the conveyor belt. In the bottom-left corner, the attribution "©European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS" is visible. This image illustrates a standing water body in an active gravel pit or related extractive industrial site.
